reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that orchestrates benchmark-based agent profile evaluation, candidate optimization, strict acceptance, snapshotting, and rollback through registered evolution tools.

summaries.zh: 通过冻结基准评测、生成候选配置并在严格比较后接受或回滚，帮助 DeepSeek Harness 迭代 Agent Profile。
summaries.en: Helps DeepSeek Harness iteratively improve Agent Profiles by evaluating frozen benchmarks, generating bounded candidates, and accepting or rolling back changes based on strict score comparison.

capabilities: launches target, evaluator, and optimizer subagents
evaluates agent profiles against frozen benchmarks
modifies allowlisted profile files through bounded operations
records scores, session identifiers, and run events
